title: Stable layout and current notification conditions
description: Run from the repository root with private VITE_PORT/GATEWAY_PORT, an isolated Agent Chrome FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT and FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_EVIDENCE. The helper starts only a protocol fixture and its own Vite process, then closes both and its own tab. It proves presentation, not gateway derivation or native acceptance. Refetch-notice recording also requires ffmpeg on PATH.

prove.intent: Consume fixture snapshots through the real socket/query adapter, require fixed content positions through repeated reads, reconnect and notice changes, and check the opened tray at 1280px and 414px.

result.intent: Require all layout assertions and owned teardown to pass.

refetch.intent: On mounted run detail and Evals, retain last-known notice text through held replies and require exact stable content positions across success/error/refetch at 1280px and 414px. Save actual CDP before/after frames and recordings. No gate action or trial launches.

refetch-result.intent: Require both mounted views and owned teardown to pass.
